Name: Calico Farm Cat (1.6 UPDATED)
Author: gabrielsfeather
Description: [b]This mod replaces the farm cat with a calico version! This will replace all cat options, so no matter which cat you choose on character creation (or have already on an existing farm), this will turn it into the calico.[/b]

Downloads.Description: Working UPDATED mod for 1.6! This changes all farm cat types into the calico skin. I also fixed a random pixel graphical error so the one white pixel will no longer show up during walking animations.

Manifest.Name: calico farm cat
Manifest.Description: Changes gray farm cat into a calico cat.
Manifest.Author: felix
